canonical_name: Law of large numbers (Bernoulli frequency form)
canonical_statement: For a jointly independent identically distributed sequence of Bernoulli trials with success probability p on a probability space, the empirical frequency of successes among the first n trials converges almost surely to p as n tends to infinity.
domain_and_universes: Provisional: universe u; Ω : Type u; MeasurableSpace Ω; probability measure μ on Ω; X : Nat -> Ω -> Real; p : Real
hypotheses: the X i have a common Bernoulli(p) law
equivalently X i is {0,1}-valued almost everywhere with expectation p, subject to checked bridges
conclusion: For μ-almost every ω, Tendsto (fun n => (sum i in range n, X i ω) / n) atTop (nhds p)
